facts.text: The `pi()` function in `.pi/config/tern-pi.zsh` reads its runner path from `TREBOL_TERN_RUNNER`, falling back to a hardcoded `/Users/swarm/...` path, so the fallback is machine-specific. It intercepts only when `command -v node` succeeds.
The installed shell block sets `TREBOL_TERN_RUNNER` to the runner path and sources the dispatcher only in interactive shells.

`#modelPickerNode` in `.pi/lib/tern/bridge.ts` builds the Tern model picker. It emits `{group,label,count}` entries in `order` for Favorites and provider groups, puts model ids (`provider/id`) as strings in `order`, and puts details in `items`. It is around line 957, not 851.

Pi native auto-compaction triggers when context tokens exceed `contextWindow - reserveTokens` (`shouldCompact`, only when enabled). Pi's settings define no absolute token threshold, so native compaction does not enforce a fixed 330,000-token ceiling.

Trebol removed the workspace-path restriction from `apply_patch`: `resolvePatchPath` resolves paths without rejecting ones outside the workspace, and CHANGELOG lists this under Unreleased Fixed. The Bash workspace check removal is not evidenced here, since `swarm-bash.ts` still imports `checkAllowedPath`.
